categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and fixes transaction origin deanonymization caused by serving evicted transactions to requesting relay peers.
categories.rationale: Re-adding unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool under `-privatebroadcast` undermines origin privacy by leaving dropped transactions held exclusively by the originating node and served to any peer that asks.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallet.h`.
categories.rationale: Prevents the wallet from resubmitting unconfirmed transactions upon startup, wallet load, or periodic rebroadcast intervals when `-privatebroadcast` is active, avoiding unintentional deanonymization of wallet transactions.
